d: Pakistan has warned its nationals against begging in Saudi Arabia during Hajj and Umrah. The Pakistani Embassy released an AI-generated video showing pilgrims being detained and deported for begging. Saudi Arabia banned begging nationwide in 2021, and more than 50,000 Pakistanis have reportedly been deported since then. Pakistanis have also faced deportations from several other countries. Meanwhile, Pakistan continues to borrow from the IMF and countries including China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and the US. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
